record.title: Are all Artin algebras virtually Gorenstein?
record.statement: Are all Artin algebras virtually Gorenstein, i.e. for every Artin algebra \(\Lambda\), does \(P^{\prec\infty}_\Lambda=I^{\prec\infty}_\Lambda\) hold, where \(P^{\prec\infty}_\Lambda=\operatorname{CM}(P_\Lambda)^{\perp}\) and \(I^{\prec\infty}_\Lambda={}^{\perp}\operatorname{CoCM}(I_\Lambda)\)?

record.title: Full strongly exceptional sequences of line bundles on smooth toric varieties

record.title: Sufficiency of the area-constraint counting conditions for local uniqueness
record.statement:
The report conjectures that the counting conditions
\[
|T|\ge 2|V|-5,
\qquad
|T'|\le 2|V'|-5
\quad\text{for every nonempty subset }T'\text{ of triangles},
\]
are sufficient for local uniqueness of a triangulated triangle with fixed triangle areas when the vertices are in generic position.

record.title: Farrell–Jones conjecture for algebraic K-theory for word-hyperbolic groups
record.statement:
Let $R$ be an associative ring with unit and let $G$ be a word-hyperbolic group. Then the Farrell–Jones conjecture for algebraic $K$-theory with coefficients in $R$ is true for $G$; equivalently, the assembly map
\[
H_n(E_{\mathcal{VCyc}}(G);\mathbf K_R)\xrightarrow{\cong}K_n(RG)
\]
is bijective for all $n\in\mathbb Z$.

record.statement:
For every finite group $G$, every prime $p$, and every faithful irreducible $G$-module $M$ over a field of characteristic $p$, there is an absolute constant $C$ such that
$$
\dim H^2(G,M)\le C\,\dim M.
$$

record.statement:

$$H^1(k,G) \longrightarrow \prod_{v\in\Omega_k} H^1(k_v,G)$$

is injective.

record.title: Kimmerle’s Prime Graph Conjecture for Integral Group Rings
record.statement:
For every finite group $G$, the Gruenberg–Kegel (prime) graph satisfies

$$\pi(G)=\pi\bigl(V(\mathbb{Z}G)\bigr),$$

where $V(\mathbb{Z}G)$ is the normalized unit group of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$; the vertices of $\pi(X)$ are the primes occurring as orders of elements of $X$, and distinct primes $p,q$ are adjacent if and only if $X$ contains an element of order $pq$.

record.title: Hall’s quantitative isoperimetric conjecture
record.statement:
For every integer $n\ge 2$, there exists a constant $C(n)$ such that every Borel set $E\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ with $0<|E|<\infty$ satisfies
\[
A(E)\le C(n)D(E)^{1/2},
\]
where $B$ is the unit ball, $r_E=(|E|/\omega_n)^{1/n}$,
\[
A(E):=\inf_{x\in\mathbb{R}^n}\frac{|E\mathbin{\triangle}(x+r_EB)|}{|E|},
\qquad
D(E):=\frac{P(E)}{n\omega_n^{1/n}|E|^{(n-1)/n}}-1.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2006/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1317), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
